title: スプリンターズSの後に・キラキラ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono is victorious! The monumental clash gets a standing ovation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono takes in all the happy faces in the stands. The familiar sight solidifies her resolution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes a beeline for the runners' tunnel to find me.
